name: truemetrics
long_description:
truemetrics helps logistics companies to find their customer's faster. By detecting and mapping entrances, we help GLS, a key logistics company in Europe, save 32.7 seconds on each delivery.

The way couriers navigate is broken.

“You Have Arrived At Your Destination!” — or so Google Maps thinks. In reality, the way couriers navigate is broken: No parking, hard-to-find entrances, and labyrinth-like apartment and office complexes can turn the last meters of delivery into a time-consuming puzzle.

truemetrics provides parking positions and entrance locations to enable faster drop-offs. Our data is generated by analyzing sensor data from drivers' smartphones, allowing truemetrics to identify precise parking and entrance locations, thereby simplifying the last meters of delivery.
one_liner: We show couriers where to park and enter a building.

launches.title: truemetrics - helping logistics companies deliver to their customer’s doorstep
launches.tagline: truemetrics provides logistics companies with precise delivery coordinates to guide couriers to their customer's doorstep.
launches.body:
### **_TL;DR_**

truemetrics provides logistics companies with precise delivery coordinates to guide couriers to their customer's doorstep. Our tech enables GLS, one of Europe’s biggest logistics companies, to speed up their deliveries by 2-10 minutes.\
\
Hi! We are Ingo, Jan, and David and we believe that **the way how couriers navigate is broken.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74016&key=user_uploads/1295475/c9886fc5-f687-4973-b936-d2a54ddae884)

“You Have Arrived At Your Destination!” — or so Google Maps thinks. In reality, the way couriers navigate is broken: No parking, hard-to-find entrances, and labyrinth-like apartment and office complexes can turn the last meters of delivery into a time-consuming puzzle.

### **Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=74016&key=user_uploads/1295475/58631705-41f1-4a39-8f74-075582b6bdcb)


[truemetrics](https://truemetrics-26059762.hs-sites-eu1.com/en/product-presentation) provides parking positions and entrance locations to enable faster deliveries. Our data is generated by analyzing sensor data from drivers' smartphones, allowing truemetrics to identify precise parking and entrance locations, thereby simplifying the last meters of delivery.

### **Team**

During his management of Wolt's operations in three of Germany's four regions, David often faced challenges with inefficiencies in the last 50 meters of delivery. Together with Jan and Ingo, he started truemetrics to overcome these problems. Ingo contributes 10 years of engineering and entrepreneurial experience, along with a successful exit. Jan Bischof holds a PhD in Control Theory and has developed software and AI solutions for nearly a decade.

### **Ask: How you can help**

* [Please connect us with COOs and CTOs from your network!](https://mailto:david@truemetrics.io)
* We would be happy to hear your feedback! [Discover the biggest address fuck-ups](https://www.demonstrator.truemetrics.cloud/map) and share with us [your favourite navigation mishaps](https://forms.gle/ugDzhR6YTWfMdWaM9).
